titles.romaji: Koi Suru Tenshi Angelique: Kagayaki no Ashita
titles.native: 恋する天使アンジェリーク ～かがやきの明日～

description: Ange is now trapped in the Seijuu Universe, and cannot leave until she awakens Seijuu's Queen. In order to do this, she must gather nine new guardians. It sounds like a fairly simple task, but how can she convince these men to tear away from their own lives and protect the life of another?
